description: This file defines the AggregateException class in the GuzzleHttp\Promise namespace, representing an exception thrown when multiple errors occur in promise operations.

classes.name: AggregateException
classes.description: An exception class used to indicate multiple errors occurred during promise operations, extending the RejectionException class.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AggregateException with a message and reasons array, formatting the exception message to include the number of rejected promises.
